value.name: SGIP - Residential Solar and Storage Equity
value.administrator: Southern California Edison (SCE), under the CPUC's Self-Generation Incentive Program
value.description: Storage incentive of $1,100/kWh paired with a solar incentive of $3,100/kW, funded via a $280 million CPUC-authorized budget that opened for reservations June 2, 2025. Administered by SCE across its entire distribution territory, which includes Newport Beach/Orange County.
value.eligibility: PG&E or SCE residential customers (general market tier)

battery_programs.notes: Same statewide CPUC-administered SGIP program already confirmed for other SCE-territory records this session, reused as a utility-level fact.

value.name: Eligibility Checklist for Solar Photovoltaic Permitting (compliance demonstration)

Completed Standard Electrical Plan (Solar PV Standard Plan, for systems 10kW or smaller) or a full electrical plan with disconnect locations, module/string counts, inverter specs, one-line diagram, grounding/conductor details, and equipment cut sheets
Roof plan showing panel layout, roof access point, fire-code-compliant access pathways, fire classification, and required labels/markings

Structural Criteria for Residential Rooftop Solar Energy Installations (expedited) or, for non-qualifying systems, stamped structural drawings/calculations from a licensed civil or structural engineer
Credit Card Authorization Form (for electronic submittals, to pay the plan check fee at time of submittal)

required_documents.notes: Per the City's own 'Submittal Requirements: Solar Photovoltaic Permitting for One- and Two-Family Dwellings' information bulletin, for systems 10kW or smaller using the standard (non-SolarAPP+) submittal path.

value: Schedule an on-site inspection by calling the Building Division's inspection request line at (949) 644-3255, or electronically via the city's Building Permit Inspection Request/Status page
Requests received before 6:00 AM are scheduled for that same day

Be prepared to show conformance with all technical requirements in the field; the inspector verifies the installation matches the approved plans and applicable code, including module/model match, proper grounding, secure fastening, correct conductor sizing, and required PV/AC/switch signage

value.program_or_pathway: SolarAPP+ (single-family/duplex only) or the City's standard streamlined Combination permit path (systems 10kW or smaller, all other project types)
other_conditions: A Combination permit is required for solar PV systems with a maximum power output of 10kW or less; Planning review is required for all solar PV installations
Single-family and duplex residential projects are only eligible through SolarAPP+; all other projects must be submitted through the City's CiViC portal

value.name: Solar Photovoltaic Plan Check Fee
value.notes: Per the City's own Submittal Requirements bulletin, revised per AB 1414 (chaptered October 15, 2017). Due at time of electronic submittal.

value.name: Solar Photovoltaic Permit Fee
value.notes: Per the City's own Submittal Requirements bulletin. Due in person for permit issuance and plan release.
